basic_info.description: Charming tunnel entrance home on a prime Central Sunset block. The main level features two spacious bedrooms that overlook the deep & inviting backyard. Adjacent to the bright kitchen is an elegant dining room. An ornate fireplace gives the living room a nice refined feel. Gorgeous hardwood floors cover most of the main level. The large tile bathroom features a separate shower and tub. Downstairs offers abundant space for parking, storage, and laundry. The roof was replaced in 2021, along with other practical upgrades. 1758 32nd Avenue is ideally situated near all the best shops along Noriega, and just a short stroll to Ocean Beach and Golden Gate Park. Don't miss it!
